objective: A frozen census on the 5 x 5 tube (two runs, 1 to 48 then 1 to 64 lags) and the 7 x 7 tube (one run of 1 to 72 lags, then 1 or 2) at g = 3: for every schedule with every stage balanced, each original ring's time length from ring (0, 0) (the earliest lag at which a route of the growing network reaches one of its own cells, each confirmed by an explicit freeze that leaves one route open, A41) and its plain hearing lag; the metric outcomes and the deaf distance; positives checked with the independent second code and one size past.
title: Time lengths of a growing plane
